snp4.16:1.5: The Buddha spent his next-to-last lifetime in the Tusita heaven, one of the highest levels on the sensual plane.
snp4.16:7.4: The fact that the Buddha answers this question in a straightforward manner illustrates the point that abandoning habits and practices does not mean having undefined precepts or practices—or no precepts or practices at all. See Sn 4:13, note 3.
snp4.16:21.4: Ekodi-bhūto. A quality of concentration attained in the second jhāna.
snp4.16:21.5: vv. 955–975. See also: SN 35:117; SN 35:200; AN 4:28; Thag 3:8; Thag 5:8; Thag 6:2; Thag 18.
